response.rationale: Reach z-score of 3.627 is a large, flagged deviation (~3.6 baseline sigmas), and the own-action confound flag is False, so this is unlikely to be the harness's own prior bid/budget change landing in the data. OSA z-score of 0.0 rules out an organic supply-side driver. The concurrent CPM decline (z=-2.006) alongside the reach surge is most consistent with a genuine market shift — likely a competitor bid pullback / competition softening letting this cell win more impressions at lower clearing prices, rather than pure demand heat (which would typically push CPM up). A real, reactive-worthy market signal in the surge direction.
